action.mutates: runs {{LOCALDIR}}/bin/rdiff.sh /run/p8test-rdiff/snap once (it only reads); its report goes to /run/p8test-rdiff/report.txt
runs rdiff.sh /run/p8test-rdiff/snap INTERACTIVE once with three ENTERs on stdin (it only reads); its output goes to /run/p8test-rdiff/interactive.txt

writes /etc/rsnapshot.d/rsnapshot-p8testpre.conf (snapshot root /var/tmp/p8test-pre-snap, one backup point /etc/hostname) and runs rsnapshot daily with it once, which creates /var/tmp/p8test-pre-snap/daily.0
